// Function to insert entries before the closing brace of a language dictionary
function insertForLang(lang, entries) {
    const marker = '["' + lang + '"] = new Dictionary<string, string>';
    const idx = content.indexOf(marker);
    if (idx === -1) {
        console.error('Marker not found for:', lang);
        return;
    }
    // Find the closing of this dictionary: next "};"
    const closeIdx = content.indexOf('};', idx);
    if (closeIdx === -1) {
        console.error('Closing not found for:', lang);
        return;
    }
    
    // Insert before closeIdx
    const before = content.substring(0, closeIdx).trimEnd();
    const after = content.substring(closeIdx);
    content = before + ',\n' + entries + '\n            ' + after;
    console.log('Successfully injected keys for:', lang);
}
